findings.title: 6a does not drain on a real Windows shutdown (real-shutdown finding), fix deferred to owner
findings.detail: FINAL_REPORT 'Restart test': down.ps1 child exits 0xC0000142, 6b ends 0xC000026B, next start 'last shutdown unclean'. FEAT-008 blocker defect; real-restart verification deferred by owner decision 2026-10-20; rows stay deferred. Phase 2 gate should confirm the owner accepts shipping with it open.

findings.title: pre-commit personal-value lint scans the working tree, not the staged blobs
findings.detail: ossctl lint personal reads working-tree files; with partial staging the committed content can differ from what was scanned. Scanning staged blobs (git show :path) would be exact. gitleaks already uses --staged.
